description: 50 complex multi-policy AUA queries for LLM-as-judge RAG evaluation. Each query intentionally spans 2-5 policies to stress retrieval and synthesis.

queries.query: We are creating a new Vice President of Research position. Which existing policies govern research oversight and reporting lines, and what would need to be updated so that researchers and research center directors now report to the VP of Research?
expected_relevant_policies: Appointment, Retention, and Promotion and Faculty Titles.pdf

queries.query: AUA wants to establish a University Ombudsperson role. Which existing AUA policies cover grievance reporting, whistleblowing, and conflict resolution, and how would this new role interact with them?

Conflict of Interest for Administration, Faculty and Staff.pdf
